description: The bar chart illustrates the average JGA score across different turn IDs for two categories, represented by orange and yellow bars. The horizontal axis, labeled "Turn ID", contains 14 categories ranging from 0 to 26 in increments of 2, while the vertical axis, labeled "Avg. JGA Score", has a linear scale from 0.2 to 1 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The chart displays grouped bars, with each group consisting of two bars representing the two categories, distinguished by orange and yellow colors as indicated by the legend. The orange bars consistently have higher values than the corresponding yellow bars across all turn IDs, with the highest average JGA score of approximately 0.95 at turn ID 0 for both categories, and the lowest scores at turn ID 24, with the orange bar at around 0.65 and the yellow bar at approximately 0.3. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and there is no visual emphasis on any specific bars.
